north_star: a smaller typed tensor program that predicts natural/OOD behavior and held-out interventions, composes, and supports selective edits
reporting_rule: Never average or substitute ledger values across currencies. Every percentage must retain its scope, null, and denominator.

representation.claim: The network is exactly writable as typed tensor operations; this alone does not compress or interpret it.

analytic_interface_substitutability.scope: whole-model PCA/head bottleneck plus composed analytic fold
analytic_interface_substitutability.claim: A compressed analytic interface can preserve nearly all floor-relative behavior.
analytic_interface_substitutability.caveat: This is interface fidelity, not a short human-legible program and not the composed named-stand-in result.

named_variable_understanding.currency: recovery of module behavior by frozen token+topic+previous-token variables
named_variable_understanding.scope: four independent FineWeb draws; local/module replacement ledger
named_variable_understanding.claim: Simple named covariates explain a stable minority of module behavior.
named_variable_understanding.caveat: Not directly comparable to path-ablation headroom or whole-model composed recovery.

causal_path_coverage.currency: joint mean-ablation delta-CE / all-head+all-MLP mean-ablation delta-CE
causal_path_coverage.scope: 26 named head/top-SVD paths on held FW[448:600,:128]
causal_path_coverage.claim: The verified named paths cover about one ninth of global ablation headroom.
causal_path_coverage.caveat: Mean-ablation interactions are large: joint-234 is 2.87x the sum of positive single paths.

legacy_composition_stress_test.scope: 36 stand-ins installed together in the running model
legacy_composition_stress_test.claim: This older controlled arc demonstrates severe composition failure among individually useful stand-ins.
legacy_composition_stress_test.caveat: This is a diagnostic predecessor, not the current shipped composite. It uses a different surrogate family and denominator from analytic-interface substitutability.

content_passthrough_diagnostic.currency: recovery with middle content preserved, reported against the all-36 mean-ablation denominator
content_passthrough_diagnostic.scope: 26 scaffold replacements with selected content live
content_passthrough_diagnostic.claim: Preserving content triples whole-model recovery from 0.124 to 0.392, localizing much of the gap to contextual content and compounding.

smooth_interface_predictability.currency: recovery by a low-rank upstream smooth-map feature interface
smooth_interface_predictability.claim: A distributed learned interface is strongly predictive even when named covariates are not.
smooth_interface_predictability.caveat: This measures predictive compression, not semantic legibility.

current_composite_residual_localization.currency: signed nats and shares of current K=3072 ship CE damage within explicitly named partitions
current_composite_residual_localization.scope: the 2^3 factorial crosses attention, MLP0-2, and deep replacements over global copy/novel-frequency cells and the separate most-frequent-token partition
current_composite_residual_localization.claim: Held-out MLP0-2 Shapley effect is 0.728 of 0.873 global ship nats and 1.078 of 1.176 novel-rare nats; the early group is the stable dominant residual source.
current_composite_residual_localization.caveat: The prior 0.500 result selects the 100 most-damaged token types, whereas the prior 0.499 group share and factorial 0.319 partition use the 100 most-frequent token types. They cannot be multiplied. Interactions consume 43-64% of each cell's total effect, so the Shapley localization licenses only a joint-ship correction, not an independent module claim. The v1 copy mask covers distances 2-65 and its rare vocabulary is split-specific; global group allocations remain valid but token-cell labels require a corrected frozen-stratum replication.

causal_instrument_validation.currency: held-out intervention prediction and circuit-localization diagnostics
causal_instrument_validation.scope: question circuit and disjoint output classes
causal_instrument_validation.claim: Polynomial pairwise terms predict interventions; a weights-only output basis locates circuits but is not yet a sufficient causal control basis.

arithmetic_complexity_bounds.currency: scalar multiplication gates in the frozen sum_i c_i(a_i.x)(b_i.x) grammar
arithmetic_complexity_bounds.scope: randomized numerical coefficient-space output-flattening bounds for full MLPs 0,1,2,11,17; exact inertia certificate for the question scalar slice
arithmetic_complexity_bounds.claim: All audited full-vector maps lack near-exact coefficient degeneracy at registered tolerances through 1e-4, while the selected scalar slice has an exact one-product certificate.
arithmetic_complexity_bounds.caveat: The 1152 result is a two-sketch floating-point diagnostic whose thresholds all lie below the observed spectral tails. It is neither a symbolic rank proof nor a natural-activation incompressibility result, and the practical coefficient-space knee is unmeasured.

matched_cost_causal_compiler.currency: matched-one-product question-slice replacement fidelity on natural activations
matched_cost_causal_compiler.scope: mlp11 selected positive/negative question-unembedding eigenpair; discovery and untouched held-out FineWeb rows
matched_cost_causal_compiler.claim: The exact paired gate is stable even in bf16, but exact product geometry did not earn causal preference over the best one-square program: the registered held-out KL gate failed.
matched_cost_causal_compiler.caveat: This is a rank-2 slice correction with the orthogonal MLP output live, not an MLP replacement. The square's held-out question KL is only 0.39% of zeroing the slice despite 35.4% scalar error, so reconstruction error badly overstates behavioral necessity here.

local_content_compiler_frontier.pricing_rule: Standalone parameters are primary. Native factor projections may use the amortized-new price only after independent admission and payment as a shared library; provenance in the original model does not make them free.
local_content_compiler_frontier.currency: held-out whitened R2 at a frozen 64-dimensional local content-output API
local_content_compiler_frontier.scope: clean-model MLP0-2 outputs; 32 products; sequence-disjoint 96/48/48 train/validation/test rows; not installed in the ship
local_content_compiler_frontier.claim: At standalone price, learned paired and selected native products are dominated by a smaller linear map at all three early MLPs; tensor-specific compilation is rejected at this interface. Native products are a conditional amortized frontier only if their factors are legitimately shared.
local_content_compiler_frontier.caveat: The MLP0 native arm retains 69% of linear R2 for 1/35 the new parameters, but that price excludes its two factor projections. The linear winner predicts clean local outputs rather than the current ship residual, so it licenses a ship-correction test only after group x token-cell attribution, not whole-model admission.

sequence_state_program_test.currency: best held-out low-rank RMSE improvement over row-plus-column additive prefix/suffix baseline
sequence_state_program_test.scope: 48 prefixes x 48 suffixes, 64-token prefixes and 8-token suffixes; discovery and held-out spliced FineWeb grids
sequence_state_program_test.claim: The registered compact Hankel-state hypothesis is rejected at this interface: low rank does not beat the additive baseline and the apparent ranks replicate near 19-24 rather than collapsing.
sequence_state_program_test.caveat: Splicing is strongly distribution-shifting (held-out +3.54 CE), so this rejects the present probe, not every finite-state or predictive-state representation of natural continuations.

ood_content_interface.currency: code contextual-variation capture by the prose content basis divided by code's own top-64 capture
ood_content_interface.scope: 150 code and 150 prose sequences at residual layers 8, 10, and 12
ood_content_interface.claim: The current prose-derived content basis is not a universal OOD interface: it captures only 16.6% of code variation, or 32.2% of the code-local top-64 ceiling.
ood_content_interface.caveat: It remains 3.0x above a random 64D basis on code, so it contains transferable signal; a universal compiler must test a transported or typed mixture of content coordinates rather than treating this basis as domain invariant.

controlled_tensor_head_grain.currency: published |eigenvalue|-slice head-read concentration divided by matched-rank random-subspace concentration
controlled_tensor_head_grain.scope: question@MLP11 rank 2 and pronouns@MLP17 rank 8 over three disjoint 96-row samples
controlled_tensor_head_grain.claim: The tensor slice identifies sharply concentrated reader heads at the registered circuit layers, but the whole-stack median separation gate fails.
controlled_tensor_head_grain.caveat: This is a controlled local wiring law, not yet a replacement, CE recovery, or proof that the same grain composes across behaviors and layers.

tensor_writer_specificity.currency: matched-rank within-run absolute attribution-mass top-k share and component membership at question@MLP11 and pronouns@MLP17
tensor_writer_specificity.measured_currency: top-k share and membership over positive signed component contributions
tensor_writer_specificity.original_currency: top-k share and membership over absolute component attribution mass
tensor_writer_specificity.positive_only_audit_status: noncommensurate with the published statistic; question within-run comparison narrow, pronoun measurement saturated; cross-references withdrawn
tensor_writer_specificity.status: absolute-mass null is cell-dependent: question slice is more concentrated than random, pronoun slice is substantially less concentrated than random
tensor_writer_specificity.scope: three disjoint 333-row chunks from curated_rows.pt; question counts 105/127/102 and pronoun counts 434/408/399; local census rows, not fresh oracle rows
tensor_writer_specificity.claim: With the published absolute-mass statistic, question@MLP11 concentrates above its matched-rank null (.5563 versus .4489), while pronouns@MLP17 concentrates far below its null (.5846 versus .7295). Concentration has slice-specific sign; matched-rank null subtraction, not raw share, is the informative quantity.
tensor_writer_specificity.caveat: The published .718/.482 values used different rows and are not numerically comparable to this local corpus. The within-run null gaps are valid, but they establish a local structural diagnostic—not causal sufficiency, generalization, selective editability, or whole-model programmability.

compression_selectivity_boundary.currency: class-specific versus global CE damage under rank compression, plus circuit-head marginal recovery inside the compressed background
compression_selectivity_boundary.scope: question rank sweep r4/r8/r16/r32; rank-32 question/pronoun backgrounds; eight class-specific top-unit truncation controls
compression_selectivity_boundary.claim: Compression is a useful self-consistent replacement background, but not a circuit-selective operator: class and global damage move together at every tested rank, and restoring exact named heads does not recover function inside that background.
compression_selectivity_boundary.caveat: This rejects generic compression as an extraction or selective-edit primitive at the tested interfaces. It does not reject compression as a priced fidelity component, nor behavior-specific gauges that pass direct intervention-transport tests.

current_bottleneck.interpretation: The tensor structure supplies exact identities and useful interfaces, and every top-level module has a replacement, but the certified composite still loses about 0.93 nats. Replacement scope is not reverse-engineering completeness.

ranked_actions.action: After the remaining streaming control clears, pass the real rowcache identity gate, freeze all registered FineWeb rows, and run the authoritative same-realization live-z oracle v2 at MLP0-2.
ranked_actions.why: The preliminary oracle failed before science and could not preserve its randomized derived ship. The v2 path tests whether exact missing original computation repairs CE, compares content/local/null projections, and freezes the realization so any conditional OOD conclusion is composable and reproducible.

ranked_actions.action: If the FineWeb oracle licenses a site, repeat the optimizer-free singleton screen on code using the frozen prose basis, a code-local basis, and matched nulls before fitting any predictor.
ranked_actions.why: The registered prose-content OOD claim already failed: the basis captures only 16.6% of code variation versus 51.5% for code's own top-64 basis. A FineWeb pass cannot support a whole-model content API without deciding between transported, domain-typed, and non-content residual coordinates.

ranked_actions.action: Extend the frozen group factorial to powered output slices and held-out intervention families, with corrected fixed token strata and alternate ship backgrounds.
ranked_actions.why: Token CE localizes the deployed residual but cannot establish causal transport or selective edits; large negative interactions also require checking whether a fragment's intervention response changes with its replacement background.

ranked_actions.action: Execute the preregistered no-teacher-forcing L8-to-L11-to-L14 gauge-transport triangle, first gating destination-subspace sufficiency, then direct response prediction, chain composition, and alternate-background transfer.
ranked_actions.why: Local bases often locate circuits, but affine donor transport has near-zero median fidelity, repeated content patching teacher-forces every clamp, and the output basis preserves only 13.5% of oracle removal damage. The commuting triangle separates a locator failure from transport failure and transport failure from composition failure while pricing the physical map, coordinate field, and repeated interfaces.

ranked_actions.action: Only after oracle and transport gates pass, fit the residual predictor and factor it through linear, native-product, paired-product, and tensor-head-grain programs at standalone and amortized prices.
ranked_actions.why: The early product frontier and Hankel probe rejected premature structural compression, while the compression rank sweep shows class and global behavior degrade together rather than exposing a privileged circuit core. Tensor structure should compete only at a causally licensed, OOD-scoped interface where simplicity can be tested for composition and editability.

registry_inventory.scope: inventory only; counts are not a fraction of model computation
